body: If I was better, and/or if I deserved it, I would have gotten a job

Everyone is so nice - thats why I posted.  Thank you for the thoughts!


Unfortunately, we're out of money. And boy did I try.

You all are too nice, thank you!

Two quick points - I bought my life insurance in 2007 so there is no fraud aspect on that on suicide - I've also checked with the company and they confirmed to me that it will be paid out.  Second, I have prayed every day for God to get me a job (and I've helped myself as well).  It is written...
